metadata.description: Architect-as-orchestrator for Claude Code: Claude writes specs and verdicts, an external model on your own OpenAI-compatible relay writes all the code (agentically via the Codex CLI, or as chat completions), and a clean-context Claude advisor reviews every deliverable.

plugins.name: delegating-to-external-llm
plugins.description: Claude is only the brain: every implementation task is routed to the relay model (follows your codex config) with a per-task reasoning effort, verified by re-running tests, and reviewed by llm-advisor before it ships.
